question: How did the discerner of desired forms destroy the position of one Kauśika but not another?
premises: A discerner of desired forms acted.
He made one Kauśika lose his position.
He did not do so to another Kauśika.
inference: The power to discern desired forms discriminates in its effects.
uncertainties: The identities of the two Kauśikas are not specified.
plain_english: The discerner of desired forms made one Kauśika lose his position, but not the other Kauśika.
